title.value: Bias-inducing geometries: an exactly solvable data model with fairness implications
title.justification: The paper's title is explicitly mentioned in the provided document, making it straightforward to extract.
title.quote: Bias-inducing geometries: an exactly solvable data model with fairness implications

extractions.description: This paper explores the role of data geometry in machine learning (ML) bias. It introduces a high-dimensional T-M model to understand bias inheritance and propose theoretical solutions. It focuses on the effectiveness of bias mitigation strategies, through loss-reweighing and coupled learning models, to achieve fairness without compromising accuracy. The study investigates sources of bias and proposes mitigation protocols in simplified synthetic settings to enhance theoretical understanding of bias in machine learning systems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily addresses issues related to fairness and machine learning bias. Its focus is on the data geometry that leads to bias in ML models and how to mitigate it through theoretical frameworks, without direct concern for climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Machine learning (ML) may be oblivious to human bias but it is not immune to its perpetuation.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development. Instead, it examines fairness and bias in machine learning data, which are related to social ethics and technology rather than environmental or climate concerns.
primary_category.quote: The present work aims to clarify the role played by data geometry in the emergence of ML bias.

secondary_categories.justification: Since the primary focus is not related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development, no secondary categories can be justified.
secondary_categories.quote: We introduce an exactly solvable high-dimensional model of data imbalance, where parametric control over the many bias-inducing factors allows for an extensive exploration of the bias inheritance mechanism.

primary_sub_category.quote: Our theoretical analysis of this approach shows that the coupled strategy can strike superior fairness-accuracy trade-offs.
